name: River golem
notes: Origin on the riverbed under the pelvis, face +Z, up +Y, 26 m tall. Authored pose is the full stand with arms hanging and hands open; the character's right arm is at -X. Joints rise 0...1 (0 = crouched, pelvis sunk 9 m, torso leaning 35 deg, legs folded), stride -1...1 (legs swing 25 deg, arms counter-swing 20 deg), arm -1...1 (right arm raise forward 150 deg), fist 0...1 (right hand closes 95 deg), glow 0...1 are empty drivers; child parts mimic them. Followers core and runesBody, runesTorso, runesArmR, runesArmL, runesLegR, runesLegL switch option at glow 0.05.
parts: stacked displaced granite boulder lofts for pelvis, torso, head, arms and legs, 64 and 48 radial
moss cushions and tapered river weed strands on shoulders, head, belt and elbows
riveted iron bands at both wrists
emissive cyan rune seams laid on the stone, dark slate cracks when unlit
chest lantern core with glass dome and iron ring
right hand with four fingers and a thumb that close
style: Weathered river granite giant, wet lower limbs, moss and weed, iron bands, cyan rune glow, original design.
summary: 26 m river golem: stacked displaced granite boulders, moss and river weed, riveted iron wrist bands, emissive cyan rune seams, glass lantern core, joints rise, stride, arm, fist, glow.
